## `GetShopifyLoginUrl`

**GET** `/sso/shopify/api/token`

Generate Shopify Multipass Login URL

Generates a Shopify Multipass login URL using the provided LoginRadius access token. Uses Shopify's Multipass feature to create a single sign-on URL that authenticates the user into the Shopify store.

### Example

```c#
public static async Task CallGetShopifyLoginUrl(LoginRadiusClient client) {
    string accessToken = "<accessToken>"; //Required
    string store = "<store>"; //Required
    Option<string> returnUrl = new Option<string>("<returnUrl>"); //Optional

    try {
        var response = await client.ShopifySSO.GetShopifyLoginUrlAsync(accessToken, store, returnUrl);
        Console.WriteLine(response);
    } catch (Exception e) {
        var lr = LoginRadiusException.From(0, null, e);
        Console.Error.WriteLine(lr.Description);
    }
}
```

### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `access_token` | query | string | yes | Access Token of the User |
| `store` | query | string | yes | Shopify store domain (e.g., mystore.myshopify.com) |
| `return_url` | query | string | no | URL to redirect the user to after login |
